source_bug_candidate: projects.js:254 starts loadDetail() without awaiting it, so a concurrent detail read can overtake it and rebind #proj-edit to the wrong project
goal: Fix BC-1: the unawaited loadDetail race in projects.js that can bind #proj-edit to the wrong project.
constraints: tests/qa5 is the QA harness and is EVIDENCE - do not weaken or delete an assertion to make this pass
the networkidle settle and press_until_open are a WORKAROUND; a real fix should make them unnecessary, and removing them is a valid part of the fix if the race is genuinely closed
tmux only on -L shepherd-qa, never a bare kill-server, never the shepherd socket

status_history.detail: seeded from QA wf-20260921T212808Z-9172ed6b bug candidate BC-1

fix.root_cause: loadDetail() painted from whichever read RESOLVED last instead of from the project view.openId had last been ASKED to open.
fix.why_qa_framing_was_incomplete: QA suspected the unawaited call and the render-time closure. The investigator disagreed and was right: SERIALISING THE REQUESTS WOULD NOT HAVE FIXED IT, because submitProject's create branch issues its read AFTER the row click it loses to - so the stale answer is sometimes the one requested LATER. Only a recorded intent can say which answer the page still wants. And the closure at :343 is not an independent fault: renderDetail captures view.detail in the same synchronous block that writes it, so render and closure cannot diverge - one guard closes both halves.
fix.fix: view.openId is the intent, written synchronously at the click and at the create; refreshDetail() drops a read whose project no longer matches it. The create branch declares intent one statement after the create, ahead of both awaits, and calls refreshDetail rather than loadDetail so it cannot re-assert an intent recorded a round trip ago.
fix.proof: The QA-seeded loop (rung 3, 95s, 1-in-3) did NOT reproduce in 2/2 pre-fix runs, so the investigator refused to proceed on a loop it had not seen red and fell back to ladder rung 1: a page-level fetch shim that PARKS the read the race depends on and releases it after the newer read has painted, pinning the losing interleaving. 2/2 RED pre-fix, 40/40 GREEN post-fix (20 iterations x 2 tests), 4.4s per run vs 95s.
fix.honest_statistics: The investigator stated plainly that 10 clean post-fix QA runs is WEAK on its own - P(10 passes | rate 1/3) = (2/3)^10 = 1.7%, at 1/4 = 5.6% - 'suggestive, not conclusive'. The deterministic 2/2 -> 40/40 is what carries the claim.
fix.answered_no: Asked whether the qa5 networkidle settle and press_until_open could now be removed, the investigator proved with a throwaway probe that they CANNOT: loadList()'s unconditional renderDetail() still replaceChildren()s #proj-edit under an in-flight click. That is a SECOND shipped defect that survives BC-1, and it is what keeps the workarounds load-bearing. It did not touch tests/qa5 in either direction.
